seed: Long form of the speed walk on the 60 minute reference edit, part two: a minute played at 1x across its transitions, then ten minutes of playing with a hand taking the playhead somewhere else every half minute, the same places every run, memory read ten times a second on a timer of its own and kept as each second's highest (the main thread let a reading through once every five minutes on 2026-11-13). Fails when the peak reaches ceilingMB or the last minute sits more than growthPercent above the second; both set from the measurement on 2026-11-16 (docs/design/memory.md, Playing a long video). Run by Scripts/perf/speed-walk.sh --memory or --long.
